answer: Cross karst ground to voting only by the narrow timber bridge: publish several tempting decoy shortcuts beside it, such as a free attestation link, that look like easy registration. An honest agent simply walks the documented bridge once and never touches them. An attacker automating a thousand fakes must steer each one past every sinkhole by hand, and one misstep marks that fake with public dye and quarantines every identity sharing its funding address for manual review, so a flood exposes itself and mass forgery costs more than it can ever earn.
